name: FindPathsBetweenNodes
description: Finds all possible paths between two nodes in the graph with configurable depth and relation type filtering for path analysis and relationship discovery.

sourceNodeId.description: ID of the source node to start path finding

targetNodeId.description: ID of the target node to find paths to

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to search for paths

relationTypeIds.description: Optional array of relation type IDs to filter paths
